business_problem: Flo Health needed a better way to support women's health predictions, experimentation, and self-service analytics because a decentralized analytics estate could not keep up with the scale, experimentation cadence, and product intelligence required by tens of millions of users.
solution_summary: Flo Health uses Databricks Data + AI Platform to support women's health predictions, experimentation, and self-service analytics. The implementation replaced a legacy state where a decentralized analytics estate could not keep up with the scale, experimentation cadence, and product intelligence required by tens of millions of users. Health app events and cycle and symptom data move through Lakeflow Jobs and land in Delta Lake, giving teams one trusted data foundation. Unity Catalog governs access, lineage, and compliance across sensitive datasets. Databricks SQL, MLflow, and Genie operationalize models, agents, and analytics that deliver health predictions and recommendations and product experiment insights.
business_outcome: Flo Health improved women's health predictions, experimentation, and self-service analytics with measurable results including 45% building a better future for female health, 400 increase in internal monthly active users of the platform, and 46% analytics experiments run per quarter, while giving teams a faster path from governed data to production decisions.
